name: v7 baseline: the house rendering
change: The v7 house rendering in both steps (one light, one shading model, value-only contour, the house eye, the background and contact-shadow rule, two or three surface touches, the vinyl finish, one framing rule), the species notes cut to what differs, and no species reference image in either step: the drawing and the colour key only.

name: No eye recipe
change: Both steps, the Eyes paragraph removed; the species iris colour in the notes stays. Measures what the house eye recipe buys in sameness across species.
step1:
Image 1 is the part map: structure, proportion and placement only, never the look. Image 2 is the colour key, the authority on colour: one colour an area, unbroken, shaded only by light; no markings it does not show.

Draw HiBit pixel art on a 280×300 grid in the house rendering, which every species obeys whatever its material:

Light: warm key from the upper left at 45 degrees; cool fill a third as strong; one cool rim on the upper right edge.

Shading: per colour a lit tone, two shadow steps, one specular cluster on the highest lit form; occlusion where parts touch.

Contour: no outline of any colour; edges read by value alone.

Surface: the material in the two or three touches the species notes name, where the light falls; elsewhere broad smooth clusters, never texture noise.

Finish: a soft vinyl collectible, matte with one highlight.

Framing: the whole creature, wings and antennae included, spans four fifths of the frame at its larger dimension, centred, feet on a ground line one tenth above the bottom.

Ground: flat #f6f3ec edge to edge; a small soft contact shadow under the feet, nothing else.

Keep every part as Image 1 places it, facing viewer-left. Invent nothing.

Not: dither, panels, vignettes, scene, text.

{description}
